recipes.title: Peach–Grand Marnier Flan Pâtissier
recipes.summary: Vanilla-bean flan pâtissier layered with peaches caramelized in butter, sugar, orange zest and Grand Marnier.
method: Freeze the lined pâte sucrée shell until firm.
Prepare the flan base, tempering the yolks before returning the mixture to the stove to thicken.
Cool the caramelized peaches before assembly.
Layer flan base, peaches, remaining flan base, then peaches on top.
Bake until the center is set with a slight movement and the surface is deeply caramelized. Cool completely before chilling.
recipes.notes: Atelier test: two layers of peaches; no cream; one additional small yolk used in the tested batch.

recipes.title: Grand Marnier Madeleines
recipes.summary: Browned-butter madeleines built around Grand Marnier, orange, honey and overnight maturation.
method: Prepare the batter and fold in cooled browned butter.
Cover and mature overnight in the refrigerator.
Pipe or spoon cold batter into prepared madeleine molds and bake for a pronounced hump.
recipes.notes: Developed as a two-dozen batch; overnight maturation preferred.

recipes.title: Canelés de Bordeaux
recipes.summary: Vanilla canelés developed through flour, mold, maturation and high-heat caramelization experiments.

ingredients.text: Rum or Grand Marnier — optional test variable

method: Prepare a smooth, thin batter without overworking the flour.
Prepare molds and bake with an initial high-heat phase to establish the dark shell, then finish at lower heat.
recipes.notes: Archive preserves mold, flour and caramelization experiments as versioned tests.

recipes.title: Tarte Bourdaloue — Ayala Variation
recipes.summary: Pear-and-almond tart with vanilla, Seville orange, Grand Marnier and dark-rum poached pears.
method: Line tart shell with pâte sucrée.
Fill with almond cream and arrange poached pears.
Bake until the almond cream is risen and golden and the pastry is crisp.
recipes.notes: Ayala variation connects classical Bourdaloue structure with citrus and spirit notes.
